description: photo_1920x1080_420 baseline on x86_64. C libjpeg-turbo = 14312us. Rust 39% slower.

After color i16+SSSE3 interleave + IDCT DC-only fast path + strided output. Rust 33% slower than C. Perf profile: 59% in decode_baseline_planes (Huffman), 13% in IDCT, 6% in color. Huffman is the dominant bottleneck.

After 256-bit IDCT + AVX2 vertical blend. Stable 2.9GHz (no turbo). C=20224us. Rust 21% slower on 1080p 4:2:0. But Rust BEATS C on 640x480 and below (863 vs 904us = 5% faster). Gap is cache-efficiency: C uses MCU-row pipeline (hot L2), Rust does full-plane IDCT→upsample→color (cold memory). Architectural change needed for large images.
AVX2 upsample 32-sample/iter rewrite: lane crossing vperm2i128 overhead cancelled throughput gains. No improvement over 16-sample/iter. Reverted.
Row-streaming H2V2: fused upsample+color per 2 rows instead of separate full-plane passes. 24.4→23.0ms. Data stays in L1/L2.
Eliminated full-plane cb_full/cr_full allocation (~4MB for 1080p) for H2V2 path. 23.0→19.2ms. C=19.9ms. RUST BEATS C on 1080p 4:2:0 by 4%. All benchmarks now at or faster than C libjpeg-turbo.

Issue #314 fix: narrow the AVX2 4:2:0 row fast path so it no longer runs when the last MCU column needs dummy blocks (ceil(width/8) odd). Tried because the fast path FDCTs every block unconditionally, while C zeroes dummy blocks and copies the previous DC (jccoefct.c:292-312) — output diverged from cjpeg for ~half of all widths at 4:2:0, including 500x375/1000x750/1080x1080. Affected widths now take the generic per-MCU path: 1928x1080 5.004ms vs 1920x1080 4.796ms on the fast path, i.e. ~3.6% slower (also 4.5% at 1000x750, 3.2% at 3848x2160; medians of 15 runs, 3 repeats, EPYC 9554). Kept: correctness first — fused path now matches cjpeg on 576/576 swept geometries (was 516/576). Perf follow-up filed as #317 (keep the fast path for interior MCU columns, handle only the final column generically).

Issue #317: restore the AVX2 4:2:0 row fast path for interior MCU columns, leaving only the trailing partial column on the generic path. Tried because the #314 correctness fix disqualified the whole row whenever ceil(width/8) is odd (~half of all widths), costing 3.2-4.5%. Recovered most of it: 1928x1080 4.836ms vs 1920x1080 4.759ms on the all-fast path = 1.2% gap (was 3.6%); 3848x2160 0.7% (was 3.2%); 1000x750 2.0% (was 4.5%). Kept: golden fixture unchanged (byte-exact) and the C sweep shows no new divergence, so the recovery is free. Medians of 15 runs x 2 repeats, EPYC 9554.
